input.mark_source: M117 IBKR stock mark snapshot JSON

fill_price_rules.local_estimate: Use M114 local notional estimate divided by paper quantity.
fill_price_rules.marks_or_local_estimate: Use normalized mark price when available, otherwise local estimate.
fill_price_rules.require_marks: Use normalized mark price only; skip intents whose symbol has no valid mark.
fill_price_rules.slippage: Buy fills increase mark by slippage_bps; short-sale fills decrease mark by slippage_bps.

safety.description: M118 uses read-only IBKR marks as simulated paper fill reference prices. It still does not call broker order APIs, submit orders, transmit orders, or mutate a real portfolio.
